# Candle workflow and branch hygiene, 2026-10-30

## Earlier cleanup

[Preview 41077942446](https://github.com/haricot/candle/actions/runs/41077942446)
and [apply 41078119690](https://github.com/haricot/candle/actions/runs/41078119690)
passed. They archived and removed 109 old preparation branches from nine
completed campaigns, reducing the branch count from 222 to 113. Nine obsolete
workflow files were removed from Legacy orchestration; they had already been
retired from Extended. The registered Extended dynamic smoke workflow was disabled.

## Follow-up scope

The checked request in `cleanup-sm61-20261030.json` is now schema version 2.
It targets exactly 42 additional branches:

- 28 before-promotion backups from successful Extended runs 40897509915 and 41036699911.
- 13 preparation branches from the already promoted Extended run 41036699911.
- `ci/extended-examples-legacy-alias-validation`, whose exact SHA is an ancestor of the maintained Extended orchestrator.

Every removed head is first preserved by a distinct annotated tag at
`archive/candle-pruned-20261030/<original-branch>`, pointing to the exact commit.
Deletion is an atomic push with a separate SHA lease for every head. The
successful preview and apply request must have the same scope fingerprint.
Promotion and GPU job identities are checked again before removing promotion
backups. Existing physical validation archives and every immutable integration
candidate remain heads. The expected branch count after this follow-up is 71.

All 70 other non-default heads are pinned by the request. These include source
and standalone branches, orchestration branches, both sides of open PRs, image
publication evidence, the current `extended` and `cuda_legacy`, physical proof
archives and every reference belonging to queued Legacy run 40969964274.
Mistral is outside this cleanup.

The obsolete CUDA 13/SM86 `ci_cuda.yaml` has been disabled since January 2026.
Its file is removed only from the three maintained orchestration branches.
Current CUDA 12.9 SM61 image production and consumers are unchanged.
The historical `fp4-format-once.yml` registration is disabled only after
checking that no current branch contains its file and that no run is active.
Standalone, D7, ASD, security, package and current CUDA workflows are retained.

Fourteen local Git tests cover archive identity, annotated-tag collisions,
concurrent branch movement, atomic deletion, protected candidates, matching
preview scope, failed promotion, merged ancestry, orphan detection and open PRs.
The hosted cleanup repeats those tests and all live preflight checks.
No run, log or artifact is deleted, and no CUDA campaign is started or rerun.

## Current physical evidence

[Extended 41036699911](https://github.com/haricot/candle/actions/runs/41036699911)
passed hosted compilation, CPU execution, physical Pascal SM61, real Nemotron
CPU/CUDA parity for fr-FR and auto, and promotion of `extended` to
`e0dbd926ae211ee19cf1ac0f6ae4b0cbabc00646`.
Legacy 40969964274 remains queued for its dedicated local SM61 runner.
This cleanup preserves both campaigns and their immutable inputs.
